data.body:
FIX MERGED. Gerrit change 2619 reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and was submitted; it is on main. (Its first submit hit HTTP 409 -- a Makefile conflict with change 2613 -- and was resolved by rebasing and keeping both sides, the .PHONY additive case.)

RESOLUTION: 'make verify' = lint + typecheck + test, named in AGENTS.md as the pre-push contract.
Complete BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by enumeration -- make test already carries CI's
DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS, so there is no list to drift.

THE SCOPE CORRECTION THAT RESHAPED THIS, and it invalidated my own proposed fix: the pytest-only
repo-invariant gate class is ~SEVENTY modules, not the three I named in the description. The three
were simply the ones that bit me in one night. So my resolution #1 -- 'a fast make check-gates that
runs exactly these ratchet/parity tests' -- would have been a curated list, i.e. THE SAME DRIFT DEFECT
ONE LEVEL UP, and I proposed it having just spent the night documenting that pattern in 740d's
hardcoded fixture allowlist, 2593's hardcoded builder list, and the ADR .numbers markers.

THE ROOT CAUSE WAS SHARPER THAN 'some gates live in pytest': 'make check' ALREADY WAS the fast tier,
and its help text -- 'Run every check-only gate (no mutation)' -- is HOW THE FALSE GREEN ACQUIRED ITS
AUTHORITY. A contributor reads 'every check-only gate', runs it, sees green, and reasonably concludes
they have verified. So the fix corrects that claim rather than minting a third target name: adding one
would build a menu and invite picking the cheap item; deleting a false claim shrinks the surface.

MEASURED COST, quoted in make help, AGENTS.md and docs/local-dev-env.md: ~22 minutes (19230 passed,
63 skipped in 21m57s; 22m25s wall with lint and typecheck), '-n 4 --dist worksteal' documented as the
default with PYTEST_WORKERS to raise it. '-n auto' was DISQUALIFIED BY MEASUREMENT -- 7% in ~8 minutes,
extrapolating past 100 -- because much of this suite forks subprocesses. The repo had already reached
that conclusion independently (_build-and-test.yml:780 rejects -n auto; docs/coverage.md:42-47 already
prescribes -n 4), so the measurement confirmed existing reasoning rather than discovering something.

CONTROL RUN, which is what makes the timing claim meaningful: pre-edit clean tree was 19229 passed /
22m13s. The +1 is exactly the new AC3 regression test; nothing else moved.

THREE RED DEMOS, each reproducing the exact bug signature (make lint = 0, gate = 1), each reverted:
a stale mechanism-baseline entry, a dropped [ -f ] guard, an added public symbol.

ONE DEMO WAS CAUGHT BEING FAKE, and that self-check is worth more than the demo: the first attempt at
the third used an UNDEFINED name, so make lint exited 2 on ruff F822 -- and a demo where lint FAILS
proves nothing, because the entire premise is a tree lint calls CLEAN. Redone with a real definition
in isort order so RUF022 also passes.

AC3 skew closed AT THE SOURCE, proven in three states: old tracked-only listing + unstaged = PASS (the
false green); fixed listing + unstaged = FAIL; fixed listing + staged = FAIL. The verdict is now a
property of the TREE, not the INDEX.

No ratchet fired and no mechanism-ok marker was needed -- a Makefile target is not a ci_gate.
